description_en: Checks the project name of a real-time log delivery task

parameters.help_en:
The real-time log project name.

实时日志项目名称。

允许字符集（仅连字符，不含下划线）、长度范围及命名规则示例（如 'ali-dcdn-log-56'）
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html to obtain the site ID
